test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 10th December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Move with urgent haste
solution:
The correct answer is **'Rush'**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Rush** means moving with eagerness or haste.

 
 
• Example- He **rushed** towards the metro as he was getting late for work. 
 
 
 
• So clearly** 'rush'** is the perfect one
